cards.label: Online Play

cards.label: Crossplay
cards.desc: Not established by the sources checked

blocks.text: The current [Steam listing](https://store.steampowered.com/app/2255370/Directive_8020/) advertises online co-op and shared/split-screen co-op. The [PlayStation listing](https://www.playstation.com/en-us/games/directive-8020/) advertises online players and local players. Earlier launch announcements described online multiplayer as a future update; that historical wording should not be presented as the current availability.

The official game page describes Movie Night as group play for up to five players. PlayStation lists one to five players and support for up to five online players with PlayStation Plus. These are platform listings, not a claim that every platform or game mode has identical requirements.

sections.heading: Does shared screen mean split screen?

blocks.text: Steam groups shared-screen and split-screen co-op in one feature category. That combined label alone does not prove simultaneous split-screen gameplay. Check the mode description and the interface in your installed version.

Online co-op is not the same as cross-platform matchmaking. The sources checked here do not establish crossplay support, a friend pass or which combinations of platforms can join one another. Do not infer these from the online co-op label.

sections.heading: What should I check before inviting friends?

blocks.text: Update the game and read the current platform listing. Check subscription, account and ownership requirements, then use the multiplayer options actually available in your version. PlayStation says PlayStation Plus is required for online play.

The official game presentation confirms the Turning Points story tree. Available options can depend on the selected mode and settings; this page does not promise that every scene can be rewound in every mode.
